featured_reviews.name: Manish Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We got our office premises designed by SE-ARCH and it has been an amazing experience. The office looks just fantastic. Every person who walks into our office is impressed with the looks, quality of work and the attention to detail.

Since we are based in the Kalaghoda area, we wanted a combination of classic design but with a modern functional feel. The team at SE-ARCH suggested a look based on Frank Lloyd Wright's school of thought. The result has been very satisfying. It is a pleasure to come to work to such an invigorating environment. Truly recommend SE-Arch for this fantastic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Megh Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of working with Ar. Kapil sir and his team, and I can't say enough about their exceptional work. They are very professional and articulated.

Their collaborative approach and seamless communication made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

If you're looking for an architecture firm that combines creativity, expertise, and a strong work ethic, look no further, end your search at SEARCH.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran J.
featured_reviews.review_text: Have worked on many project with SEARCH architect team. Haven’t seen any architects in mumbai, who are so evolved and involved in the projects from the unseen smallest detail to the biggest seen feature of the project. It’s always a learning for us, working with the team. Their Work is very contemporary and modern. Very few professionals give comfort and space for a agency (vendors) to deliver a better project, SEARCH team is one of them. A multifaceted firm, but modest at the same time. A visit to their office is a must, beautiful view from their windows. Coffees and cookies are the best 😇, I loved it.

featured_reviews.name: Sudhir Himatsingka
featured_reviews.review_text: Completely professional firm starting from achieving the set goals, creative in giving multiple design options and sensitive to cost considerations with great attention to details and impeccable workmanship. The professional approach combined with client focus, differentiates you straight away. Your  thorough research, meticulously presented drawings provides substantial support and perfectly blends our concept into an aesthetically pleasing design. The team has vibrancy and energy that’s infectious. We appreciate your expediteness and thank you for your hard work and great attention to details.

featured_reviews.name: Qasim Mustafa Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
STUDIO FOR ENVIRONMENT & ARCHITECTURE (SE-ARCH) is amazing. They have excellent designing skills. Working with them has been a pleasure. They provided us with one of the brilliant, dynamic, unique and pleasant experiences.  Their creativity, imagination and visualisation can’t be described in few words. Their creative design work has given our office a personality. The client servicing is perfect. They did a great job of working within our constraints.   Their service is affordable and customer friendly. We experienced unique combination of Architectural and Engineering skills in their work. That’s why we prefer to call them “Archineers” instead of Architects.

I would strongly recommend this company to anyone who needs architectural and/or interior services.

featured_reviews.name: VISHNU SWAROOP
featured_reviews.review_text: SEARCH are most proficient boutique architects and interior designers. Fortunate to have worked with them on multiple projects including hotels, restaurants, banquets and premier residencies. What sets them apart is their down to earth approach of understanding the client mind, convert the need to a perfect design, minute detailing  in their design and ultimate  passion to participate in each stage of physical creation so that the original thought is preserved while catering to multiple changes in between for operational and functional reason. They are professional to the core but respect the input of the client and operation.

featured_reviews.name: Catur Jayani

Morning Sir? Apa kabar? (How are you)

With warm personality, extraordinary experience working with Mr. Kapil Bhalla so far. Very helpful, communicative and intelligent. Looking forward to some more interesting project, cheers!!!

featured_reviews.name: LAKSHMI GOYAL
featured_reviews.review_text: Search as a firm and Jayashree Bhalla as our lead architect are by far the most professional and technically skilled firm that we have come across in India. The eye for aesthetics and Jayashree’s ability to understand us as individuals and provide advise on how the visual space can be best worked upon is exceptional. My husband Suresh, I and our whole family enjoy the lovely little touches of genius that Jayashree has spread throughout our home each day. Jayashree’s care for us as individuals and the materials she works with have resulted in a home that gets a wow each time a new person walks in! We wish her and Kapil every success.

name: GA design
description:
GA Design is a multidisciplinary architecture and design practice based in Mumbai. It was founded in 1999 as Goregaonker Architects by brothers Rajan & Sachin Goregaoker. Today, the work at GA Design manifests creativity through well-choreographed architecture and interior spaces.
GA Design was set up at a time when the Mumbai metropolis was in the early stages of developing its structural and architectural milieu for modern-day living. They ventured into the market as an independent architecture firm engaged in residential building for real estate developers. As the city evolved, so did they. Steadily, they strengthened their foothold in architecture, before branching out into interior design with Shami Goregaoker and Ritu Goregaoker.
